howto.name: Upload a PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools creates one slide per page
howto.text: Each page is rendered to an image and placed as the slide background. Text is also extracted as separate slide text boxes for editability.

howto.name: Download the .pptx file
howto.text: Open in PowerPoint / Keynote / Google Slides for further editing.

faq.q: Will the text be editable in PowerPoint?
faq.a: The extracted text overlay is editable. The underlying page image stays as a backdrop. For pixel-perfect editing, you may need to remove the backdrop and rebuild from the text.

faq.q: What about embedded charts and graphics?
faq.a: They appear as part of the page image. Re-creating editable charts requires manual recreation in PowerPoint.

faq.q: Can I get one slide per section instead of per page?
faq.a: Not directly — use Extract Pages to isolate the sections first, then convert.
